title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance — Amount of a Renewal's Claim of Medical Debt
content:
**Clause.** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the medical debt a renewal claims is every patient liability posted on the patient's Riverbend accounts in the twelve whole months before the signing day, less every patient-balance adjustment posted in those same months. A posting belongs to those months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the signing day; a whole month runs from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it, so that a posting dated on the signing day's day of the month twelve months earlier is already outside. The renewal's claim is rounded half-up to the cent and is never below zero.

**Q. Which accounts are read?** Every Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account of the patient: all patient liabilities posted on them, and all patient-balance adjustments posted on them, in the 12 whole months before the signing day.

**Q. When does a month-end posting fall inside?** Hypothetical: with a signing day of 2030-03-30, a posting dated 2029-03-31 is inside (eleven whole months; the twelfth whole month counted from 2029-03-31 is completed only on 2030-03-31); a posting dated 2029-03-30 is outside (twelve whole months).

**Q. What if adjustments outweigh liabilities?** The claim is never below zero: hypothetical liabilities of 2,500.00 against adjustments of 3,000.00 give a claim of 0.00.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Liabilities of the twelve months 8,000.00 less adjustments of the twelve months 1,500.00 give a renewal claim of 6,500.00.
